mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates improving labor market conditions, which boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE declines (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL yoy change exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic expansion, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS and INDPRO increase (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines in late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.3 million units per month, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1300.0 (t-test p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 growth is positive (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strong housing market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and HOUST increase (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During Federal Reserve tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5% in 3 months), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines during monetary tightening cycles (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
